$comment: The Model Market's data (docs/specs/MODEL-MARKET.md, docs/content-data.md): prices in starfish, refunds and doubloons, the board rule's numbers, the stamps, the course quotes, the jobs, Gilda's lines (and `practiced`, hers alone) and the other stalls' keepers' own version of each, and a goodbye (`keepers`, by island). `sizes.*.quotes` are course sentences every work order of that size shows after its job's `why`. `house` is the house special (Copilot Fusion) and its own effort levels, lowest first. The grading rules stay in src/game/market/jobs.ts. Read from the active course pack by src/content/market.ts; checked by src/content/content.test.ts and `npm run content:check`. Quotes must be word for word in the cited section of this pack's snapshot (public/course/**); `hash` is the section's hash from `npm run course:refs -- 01`. Gilda's and the keepers' `text` must match their lines in voice/lines.json: change both, then regenerate the audio (docs/content-data.md).

cost.text: Models differ in capabilities, speed, and usage cost.

effort.text: Higher effort can help with complex problems, but can take longer.

quick.text: For a repository tour or a short explanation, use **Copilot Fusion** at **Standard**, or keep your current model and its default reasoning effort.

hard.text: For a difficult bug or a change across several files, consider a higher Fusion effort level or a model suited to complex coding.

noGuarantee.text: Higher effort does not guarantee a correct answer.

auto.text: **Copilot Fusion** appears in the model control, but it is not a single model. It selects models and a workflow for each request, then returns one response.

autoAside.text: Copilot Fusion is different from **Autopilot**. Fusion controls how models handle your request. Autopilot controls how independently the agent works.

autoLevels.text: These levels guide Copilot Fusion's model choices. They are not the reasoning settings of one fixed model.

autoMore.text: Higher levels can take longer and use more AI credits.

vary.text: Available models, effort levels, and context window sizes vary.

simple.text: Keep the default for this simple question.

retry.text: If the agent's response doesn't work for you, you can retry it with a different model or reasoning effort without re-typing your prompt.

noSpecific.text: You do not need a specific model for this course.

jobs.title: Give the new deckhand a tour of the repo
jobs.brief: A beginner-friendly tour of samples/book-app-web: what it does, how its files are organized, and what its tests cover. No files change.

jobs.title: Explain how filterBooks searches
jobs.brief: Does letter case affect the book app’s search? Refer to the file, and don’t change anything.

jobs.title: Track down a difficult bug in the book app
jobs.brief: Something in the book app breaks, and it isn’t obvious why.

jobs.title: Change the book app across several files
jobs.brief: One change that reaches across several of the book app’s files.

hello.text: Ahoy, Captain! Welcome to Gilda's Model Market. Trade your starfish for a model that fits the job. Bigger models cost more.

open.text: Pick a job from the board, then hire a model and set the effort dial.

auto.text: Copilot Fusion's the house special. It isn't one model: it picks models and a workflow for each job. And it isn't Autopilot, mind.

right.text: Right-sized! Here's some starfish back for hiring smart.

fair.text: Right-sized! That's a fair price for this job.

keep.text: Right-sized. Your model on its default effort is fine for a quick look. A bigger one just costs more starfish.

overEffort.text: High effort for a quick look? The default would've done it.

overAuto.text: A higher Fusion level for a quick look? Standard would've done it, for fewer starfish.

short.text: Not quite. This job needs more muscle. Retry with a stronger model or more effort.

hardAuto.text: Right-sized! A hard job suits a higher Fusion level: more capable models, and deeper reasoning.

broke.text: No starfish? They hide all over the islands. Come back when you've found some.

done.text: Every job on the board, right-sized. You've got an eye for models, Captain!

early.text: Not yet, Captain! Oren teaches models up at the observatory. Come back when he sends you down.

practiced.text: That's Oren's practice done, Captain. Ride the lift back up and tell him how it went.
